title: `termal mailbox send` CLI returns empty stdout with no receipt and no error, and no message is stored
outcome: Every `mailbox send` CLI invocation ends with either a JSON receipt (with --json) or a visible failure on stderr and a non-zero exit code; it never returns empty output with nothing stored.
acceptance: Reproduce or diagnose, with source locators, why `TERMAL_CLI mailbox send --to session-8112 --message … --idempotency-key termal-codex-windows-declared-test-credit-fix-before-pilot-v1 --json`, run repeatedly from Engram::Advisor (session-6219, Codex) at about 04:10Z on 2026-10-09, returned empty stdout within 0.3-0.6 s, with nothing useful on stderr or in $LASTEXITCODE, while no durable message appeared. Check whether TERMAL_CLI or the base URL in that session pointed at a pre-restart binary or endpoint (the host restarted at 03:54:38Z).

The CLI prints a receipt or a non-empty error with a non-zero exit code on every path, including a connection refusal, a wrong base URL, a missing binary and an unexpected HTTP status; a test covers the failure paths.
